howto.title: How to play
howto.1: Every case has one solution. Each suspect, and the victim, stands on exactly one square.
howto.2: No two people share a row or a column. Crossed-out squares are blocked.
howto.3: Pick a suspect, then tap a square to place them. Tap them again to pick them up.
howto.4: Turn on Notes (or press and hold a square) to pencil in maybes and rule squares out.
howto.5: When everyone is placed, name the person who was alone with the victim in their room.
hint.misplaced.1: Something on the board doesn't add up yet.
hint.misplaced.3a: {name} can't be at {cell}: statement {n} rules it out.
hint.misplaced.3b: {name} isn't at {cell}. Something else has to give.
hint.next.1: Try {name} next. Their statement narrows it down.
hint.verdict.1: Everyone is in the right place. Who shares {victim}'s room?
hint.verdict.2: Look only at the {room}: exactly one other person is in it.
hint.verdict.cell: Everyone is in the right place. Close the case.
library.training: New here? Start with the training case
coach.intro: Welcome, detective! Everyone here, the victim too, stood on one square, and no two people share a row or a column. Read the statements, place everyone, then find who was alone with the victim.
coach.pick: Let's start with {name}. Tap {name}'s card to pick them.
coach.first: {name} says: “{statement}” Only one square on the board fits. It's highlighted: tap it.
coach.single: {name} says: “{statement}” Taken rows and columns are crossed out, so only the highlighted square is left. Tap it.
coach.narrow: {name} says: “{statement}” The highlighted squares still fit. Which one does the statement allow?
coach.wrong: Hmm, {name} can't be at {cell}. Tap them to pick them up and look again.
coach.verdict: Everyone is in place! Look at {victim}'s room: who else is in it? Press “Name the murderer”.
coach.close: Everyone is in place! Press “Close the case”.
coach.done: Case closed: you're a detective now. A new case is waiting in the case files.
coach.silent: {name} has no statement, but every other row and column is taken. Only the highlighted square is left: tap it.
